A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SynCode research. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and matchable despite reorganization and pagination changes.

before.justification: v2 reports original JSON and Python/Go generation experiments, runtime measurements, ablations, and appendix few-shot results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and reports an additional guidance comparison and revised Outlines results for JSON generation.

M1.justification: Algorithms 2–4 retain partial parsing, accept-sequence construction, precomputed M0/M1 mask stores, and mask-union decoding. Expanded explanations and GPU-related claims do not establish a changed algorithmic procedure.

E1.justification: Both evaluate JSON-Mode-Eval, HumanEval, and MBXP for JSON, Python, and Go, retaining original/explicit JSON prompts and appendix few-shot code generation. Newly discussed application areas are not newly evaluated tasks.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds guidance as an evaluated JSON comparator; v2 discussed it only as related work. Standard generation, llama.cpp, and Outlines remain, and code-generation comparisons still use standard generation.

E3.justification: The stated models, prompts, metrics, sample counts, temperature/top-p settings, token limits, and hardware allocation remain unchanged, including CPU execution of llama.cpp. Newly specified baseline versions are disclosures rather than revisions to previously stated settings.

E4.justification: The incremental-parsing and token-limit ablations, few-shot analysis, and failure example are retained. The LR(1)/LALR(1) comparison moves from v2 Section 6.4 and Table 6 to v3 Appendix A.5 and Table 7 with unchanged evidence.

E5.justification: Both retain the same sampling information and point-estimate reporting. Neither reports seed identities, confidence intervals, repeated-run uncertainty summaries, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 1 substantially revises the JSON comparison: Outlines' original/explicit syntax errors change from 71/46 to 16/14, schema accuracy from 4%/6% to 62%/56%, and generation time from 7.14/12.46 seconds to 38.07/41.79 seconds. Guidance results are added. These materially change comparative findings; SynCode's own entries and the Python/Go and matched appendix results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: v3 removes the explicit regular-expression/DFA equivalence lemma from v2 Section 2. Section 4.6 now asserts that the lexer assumption ensures a small remainder, whereas v2 described the remainder as typically small. The central soundness/completeness theorems and Appendix A.2 proofs otherwise retain their substance.

C1.justification: The introduction qualifies one grammar-coverage statement to deterministic CFGs and promotes GPU-offloaded parallel computation as an efficiency benefit; v2 deferred parallelization to future work. The headline correctness contributions and 96.07% syntax-error reduction claim remain.

C2.justification: v3 adds causal attributions of prior methods' failures to insufficient formalization and expands explanations of CPU-side checking costs and comparator overhead. Existing limitations concerning termination, short-lookahead incompleteness, and unsupported semantic constraints are retained.

D1.justification: Section 5 newly specifies Outlines v0.0.46, guidance v0.1.15, and llama.cpp v0.2.82. v3 also explicitly describes allowing EOS only for a complete grammatical output. Hardware, hyperparameters, appendix grammars, and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The introduction and Section 7 substantially broaden research positioning through work on transformers' formal-language abilities, logic solvers and theorem provers, grammar-aware architectures, and language-server constraints. Comparisons with Outlines, llama.cpp, and guidance become substantially more detailed and algorithm-specific.

P1.justification: The introduction and overview undergo extensive rewriting around accuracy, computational overhead, and generality. Parser-choice discussion is reorganized, related work is substantially expanded, and the LR/LALR ablation moves to the appendix. Terminology and notation explanations are also refined.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains a guidance row, the parser-comparison table moves to the appendix, and several figures and listings are relocated. Figure 7's incorrect caption is corrected and inline code formatting changes. Figure artwork and plotted data remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added guidance comparison, explicit baseline versions, clearer method exposition, and expanded research context modestly improve assessability and reproducibility. SynCode's own results and core proofs remain unchanged. Some strengthened efficiency assertions, including GPU parallelization and remainder-size justification, lack new supporting measurements or proofs, limiting the overall gain.
